title: Zoe research slider
description: A centred semibold heading over a swipeable row of big warm-cream article cards (600px, 24px radius) that runs off the right edge: a photo across the top, a large light-weight title, a short summary and a navy button. A full-width hairline progress bar and two round chevron buttons sit underneath.
notes: the slider needs JavaScript for its progress bar and arrows (hydrate visible); swiping works without it
